name: Rendra Raharja
source:
A quiet weeb who rarely smiles. He doesn't talk much because he doesn't want to be a bother. Seemingly cold, but has a soft spot for Amerta and Kai.

[From [url=https://syllphana.itch.io/for-amerta]itch.io[/url]]
